# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a free, open-source, self-hostable, AI-native business application platform for small and mid-size organizations. It ships as a complete CRM out of the box, gives any organization the same no-code platform to build its own use-case-specific app on top, offers 10 ready-made industry apps to install instead of building from scratch, includes Deployment Management to package and promote customizations across environments, ships an Integration Hub to connect it to every other system a business already runs, and — underneath all of it — an AI Agent Foundry and Unified AI Gateway that let AI agents run directly against that same data model, not a bolted-on chatbot with a separate context pipeline.

## What it is, in six layers

1. **Core CRM** — Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Products, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts and Tasks, connected in one flexible sales lifecycle (Company → Opportunity → Quote → Order → Invoice), with dashboards, reports and global search.
2. **No-code platform primitives** — Custom Objects (entirely new record types, no code), Custom Relationships (any two record types, any cardinality), Screen/App Builder (named layouts by role, Draft → Publish), Business Rules (multi-condition AND/OR, 10 operators), Workflow Automation (7 trigger types, 8+ action types), custom Dashboards and Reports. An Administrator reshapes the workspace from a settings screen — no developer required.
3. **App Builder & App Catalog** — group any set of objects, screens and a dashboard into a named, publishable app with role/user-based access, or install one of 10 ready-made industry apps (Field Service, Property Management, Construction & Contractors, Professional Services, Practice Administration, Recruitment & Staffing, Real Estate Brokerage, Legal Practice, Nonprofit & Association Management, Auto Repair & Service Garage) in a few clicks, each validated, backed up and installed transactionally.
4. **Deployment Management** — a Publisher registry with namespace validation, named/versioned Solutions (a curated subset of components), export/import between workspaces, and update-with-diff for reviewing and applying a newer package version — the same "build in test, promote to production" pattern enterprise platforms use, without enterprise licensing.
5. **Integration Hub** — encrypted Connections (REST, SFTP, PostgreSQL, OData, SMTP), OpenAPI-imported Connectors usable as Workflow Automation actions, a generic REST API with hashed/scoped API keys, HMAC-signed outbound Webhooks with retry, a CSV data-exchange wizard, read-only External Objects, and scheduled Integration Jobs for recurring sync — desktop-only today.
6. **AI & Agentic Layer** — a Unified AI Gateway (bring your own Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/Google Gemini key, or route to a fully local/air-gapped model via Ollama, with automatic failover and per-agent/per-workspace token budgets), an AI Agent Foundry (named agents with a persona, a per-tool Actions checklist, persistent Memory, a shared Skills library, and delegation), Orchestration (deterministic Pipelines, schedule/webhook/workflow-fired runs), a native Model Context Protocol server & CLI, and a conversational Chat Assistant with real tool access.

## Current status

- Early Access — the desktop app itself is at v0.12.0; the website/product tracks a separate sequential version counter, now at v0.45.0
- Windows desktop edition (Tauri + Rust + SQLite): the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), backup/restore, self-service password change, PDF generation/printing, and CSV import/export all working. desktop-v0.12.0 is the latest tagged Early Access Windows installer (.exe/.msi) on GitHub Releases (unsigned); build and run from source is also supported.
- No-code platform (desktop and demo): Custom Objects, Custom Relationships, Screen/App Builder, Business Rules, Workflow Automation, Dashboards, Reports, global search, Saved Views & Bulk Actions.
- App Catalog (desktop and demo): all 10 industry reference packages install transactionally into an existing workspace.
- Deployment Management (desktop and demo): Publishers, versioned Solutions, real export/import, update-with-diff.
- Integration Hub (desktop only, real): AES-256-GCM-encrypted Connections, OpenAPI Connector import, a generic REST API secured by hashed scoped API keys, HMAC-signed Webhooks, a CSV data-exchange wizard, External Objects, and a real background-scheduled Integration Jobs engine on the Team Workspace server. The online demo simulates this layer client-side (no server to make a real call from).
- AI & Agentic Layer (desktop and demo): a native MCP server & CLI, a Chat Assistant, the AI Agent Foundry (named agents with persona, Actions, Memory, Skills, delegation), Orchestration (Pipelines/Triggers/workflow-fired runs), and a Unified AI Gateway (multi-provider routing, failover, token budgets, DLP air-gapping) are all shipped. A Context Layer adds ranked full-text search over Custom Object records (SQLite FTS5/`bm25()` — lexical relevance, not embeddings or a vector database) and real change-history for every agent's Memory.
- Team Workspace server: can be exposed on the open internet on an organization's own domain (still self-hosted, never a Lanesra-run SaaS), with opt-in TLS-aware cookies, CORS and always-on security headers.

## Core capabilities

- Companies, contacts, opportunities, products, quotes, orders, invoices, contracts, tasks
- Sales dashboards with admin-configurable KPIs, global search, CSV import/export, PDF print output
- Admin-defined Custom Objects, Custom Relationships, custom fields with validation
- Business Rules and Workflow Automation across any built-in or custom field
- Screen/App Builder (named layouts by role) and custom Dashboards (KPI/chart/record-list widgets)
- App Builder (publish a named app with enforced access) and App Catalog (10 install-ready industry apps)
- Deployment Management: Publishers, versioned Solutions, component export/import, update-with-diff
- Integration Hub: encrypted Connections, OpenAPI Connectors, a generic REST API, HMAC-signed Webhooks, CSV data exchange, scheduled Integration Jobs, unified execution logs
- Saved Views (named filter/sort/group-by combinations, reusable as a dashboard data source) and Bulk Actions (update status, reassign owner, tag, archive across a multi-select)
- AI Agent Foundry: named agents with persona, Actions, Memory (with real change history), Skills, and delegation
- Unified AI Gateway: multi-provider routing (Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/Gemini/local), automatic failover, token budgets, DLP-triggered air-gapping
- Orchestration: deterministic Pipelines, schedule/webhook/workflow-fired runs, one unified run history
- Native Model Context Protocol server & CLI, and a Chat Assistant with real tool access
- Ranked full-text search over Custom Object records (SQLite FTS5, lexical relevance, no vector database)

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design

## Frequently asked

- Is Lanesra OS free and open source? Yes — MIT-licensed, no licence key, no per-seat pricing.
- Can I self-host it instead of a cloud CRM? Yes — desktop runs fully offline on local SQLite; Team Workspace lets a small team share one instance on their own infrastructure.
- Is it just a CRM? No — the same platform underneath the CRM builds any business app, no code, or installs one of 10 ready-made industry apps, and its own AI agents run directly against that data model.
- Does it have a REST API and webhooks? Yes — the Integration Hub's generic REST API, OpenAPI connectors and HMAC-signed webhooks (desktop edition).
- How do I promote customizations from test to production? Deployment Management: curate a named, versioned Solution, export it, import it into another workspace.
- Does it use embeddings or a vector database for AI? No — free-text search over Custom Object records is ranked lexically (SQLite FTS5's `bm25()`), a deliberate choice at this scale; nothing in the product depends on an embeddings service or vector store.
